classification.difficultyReason: Match corresponding heights and horizontal lengths in opposite-side similar triangles.

content.prompt:
Two similar triangles are created by cables supporting a yacht's mast.
Solve for $h$, the height of the mast.

spec.description: Opposite-side right triangles share the mast foot. The left cable reaches the mast top; the right cable reaches the lower attachment. Ordinary source blue lines and pale purple mast are reconstructed as black outlines without decorative fill.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding horizontal lengths are 4.5 m and 1.5 m. The smaller triangle's vertical height is 1.2 m. The full mast height is unknown and has no printed diagram label.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; the full mast height is supplied in the answers.

answer.worked:
Corresponding heights and horizontal lengths are proportional.
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{h}{1.2}&=\frac{4.5}{1.5}\\h&=1.2\times3\\h&=3.6\,\mathrm{m}\end{aligned}$$
